rows.label: tlk4342014201_msg0001
rows.name:
I thought Bamibami was suspicious
from the very beginning!

rows.label: tlk4342014201_msg0002
rows.name:
Nopon prefer eating and playing
to working any day of the week.

rows.label: tlk4342014201_msg0003
rows.name:
But acting serious, talking about
group action and cooperation? That had
to be suspicious.

rows.label: tlk4342014201_msg0004
rows.name:
But changing sides for money is, in a
way, the most Nopon-like thing of all.
